template: Open {{v1}}. If a sign-in page appears, sign in with username {{v2}} and password: type the literal text {{v3}} exactly, character for character, into the password field, then submit. If a change-password prompt or welcome modal appears after login, skip or dismiss it. Then open the provisioned dashboard named Service health (use the search / dashboards menu in the top bar). Once it is displayed, report the titles of all its panels exactly as shown on the page.

If a sign-in page appears, sign in with username admin and password: type the literal text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} exactly, character for character, into the password field, then submit.
